== The render queue ==
'''Export — render queue''': pick a shape, size and codec, set the folder, and '''Render now''' — or queue several. Any render can be cancelled. Snapshots can be taken too.

Renders come from the '''full-resolution original''', with the shot's look and sound.

== Codecs ==
* '''H.264'''
* '''HEVC''' — needs a graphics-card encoder that does HEVC (on Windows).
* '''ProRes'''

== Encoders ==
; Windows : NVIDIA NVENC (recommended), Intel Quick Sync, AMD, or Windows Media Foundation — and software H.264 when none is available.
; Mac : Apple VideoToolbox — every Mac can render H.264, HEVC and ProRes.

== Rendering an Edit ==
On the Edit screen, '''Render edit''' renders the whole Edit. '''Set In / Set Out''' (Export panel) or the '''I / O''' keys mark part of it for '''Render now'''. See [[Rexy 360: Editing#Rendering the Edit|Editing]].
